messages:
alex: Quick ping — PR #2146 updates the Python SDK streaming toolcall header handling so headers survive reconnects. CI is green but we need 2 approvals before merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/2146. Also planning a tiny backport to release/v1.2. Can someone take a look today? cc @marta @sam

marta: On it, will skim now. Any particular test vectors I should focus on (content-type, auth headers, custom tool headers)?

sam: I can take this after standup. Quick Q: does this change header precedence? worried about user-supplied headers getting overridden by tool defaults.

alex: Good call — precedence is request -> tool -> sdk_defaults. Example:
```python
# merge order: request_headers <- tool_headers <- sdk_defaults
merged = {**request_headers, **tool_headers, **sdk_defaults}
```
So explicit request headers should win.

marta: Nice. Can you add an explicit test for content-type preservation? saw a flaky in earlier PRs where content-type got lost on reconnect.

alex: Yep — adding a unit that simulates reconnect and asserts content-type preserved. Also adding an integration test for Authorization + custom tool header combos.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed — unit-tests (120s), integration (540s), lint (3s).

sam: Left one comment re: var name `merged` -> `merged_headers` for clarity. tiny nit. Otherwise :eyes:

alex: Pushed rename + tests. Re-requesting reviews.

jen: I can give the second approval once the tests are green in CI.

rachel: Quick nit: add a one-line changelog entry under "SDK" for the release notes. After that I can approve.

alex: Added changelog.md entry and updated PR description to mention backport.

rachel: Approved.

jen: Approved — good to go from me.

alex: Thanks all — merging in ~30m if no objections. Will open backport PR to release/v1.2 after merge. Appreciated :rocket:
